content: अभिविधिः [अभितो विधिर्व्याप्तिः] .²1 Complete comprehension or inclusion; one of the senses of the particle आ; आङ् मर्यादाभिविध्योः <ls>P. II. 1. 13</ls>, the limit {%inceptive%} as opposed to the limit {%conclusive%} and translated by ‘from’, ‘commencing with’, ‘including’; as in आबालं -आबालेभ्यः -हरिभक्तिः (मर्यादा and अभिविधि are thus distinguished तेन विना मर्यादा, तत्साहितोऽभिविधिः). .²2 Complete pervasion, filling up or occupying completely; अभिविधौ भाव इनुण् <ls>P. III. 3. 44</ls>; also <ls>V. 4. 53</ls> and <ls>Sk.</ls> thereon.
